run_rl_training: run the RL training agent to train a model on GSM8k for math reasoning
list_rl_environments: list available RL training environments supported by tinker-atropos
check_rl_server: check if the tinker-atropos RL server and API keys are properly configured
run_rl_interactive: run the RL training agent in interactive mode for multiple training tasks
load_hermes_config: load the hermes configuration from ~/.hermes/config.yaml for model and base_url settings
